priorg_incremental.interpretation: After pack changes, Frozen PriorG rescues more true S but also flips twice as many true NS from correct raw NS to false Supported.

main_diagnosis: The audit trigger is far too permissive: 226 of 227 auditable claims changed.
Adding C48 evidence improves NS-vs-NA separation but over-converts true NA to NS.
The packer preserved safety context by never dropping baseline passages, but broad context augmentation creates new noise and alters score geometry.
Frozen PriorG becomes less compatible after the upstream score shift: raw false-S stays 3, while final false-S rises to 10.
The next front-end method needs a high-precision no-change gate, exact-addressability protection for NA, and decision-critical evidence additions rather than universal augmentation.
